101.manual_summary: The first optical load sensor on the mast reports a signal that does not match expected conditions when manual lifting mode is selected. This indicates implausible load detection.

102.manual_summary: The second optical load sensor on the mast provides a signal that is inconsistent during manual lifting mode. Load detection cannot be validated.

103.manual_summary: The start button remains active for an excessive duration while automatic lifting is selected. This is interpreted as an abnormal control input.
actions_summary: Check start button for sticking or damage

110.manual_summary: A malfunction has been detected in brake control or brake adjustment. Braking performance may be compromised.
actions_summary: Check brake adjustment and mechanical components

111.manual_summary: The electrical resistance of the brake coil is below the expected range, indicating a possible short circuit or internal fault.

112.manual_summary: The brake coil resistance is above the permissible range, suggesting an open circuit or degraded coil.

113.manual_summary: The current flowing through the brake coil is too low to ensure proper brake operation.

115.manual_summary: The truck is currently detected in wheel change mode. Normal driving and lifting functions may be restricted.
actions_summary: Exit wheel change mode if not required

116.manual_summary: The mast position potentiometer is active while optical load sensor signals are inconsistent. Mast position and load data cannot be correlated.

117.manual_summary: The truck has entered a reduced battery mode because the current demand exceeds what the battery can deliver.
actions_summary: Inspect power demand and load conditions
Recharge or replace battery if required

118.manual_summary: The battery state of charge has reached the first low threshold. Performance limitations may begin.

119.manual_summary: The battery state of charge has reached the second low threshold. Further functional restrictions may apply.

120.manual_summary: The pre-charging process of the power electronics via the controller was not completed successfully.

121.manual_summary: The battery state of charge has reached a critical low level. Operation may be heavily restricted.

131.manual_summary: An internal control error has been detected. Additional fault codes are required to identify the root cause.

140.manual_summary: The combined voltage of the accelerator signals exceeds the allowed tolerance. Input plausibility is violated.

167.manual_summary: A general battery warning has been issued, indicating abnormal battery-related conditions.

201.manual_summary: The sensor supply voltage is above the permissible range. Sensor readings may be unreliable.

202.manual_summary: The sensor supply voltage is below the permissible range, leading to unreliable sensor signals.

203.manual_summary: The tiller switch signals are incompatible or an incorrect tiller type is configured.

204.manual_summary: The creep switch signals do not match expected combinations, indicating implausible input states.

206.manual_summary: The battery voltage is below the minimum required level or the supply connection is interrupted.

207.manual_summary: The vehicle speed exceeds the allowable limit for the current operating condition.

245.manual_summary: The traction motor temperature has exceeded the permissible limit. Thermal protection may be active.

330.manual_summary: A permanent fault has been detected in the driver circuits of the power transistors.

351.manual_summary: One phase of the motor power supply is interrupted, preventing proper motor operation.

400.manual_summary: The safety self-test failed because the safety relay remained energized when a shutdown was requested.

401.manual_summary: The safety self-test failed because a contactor remained closed when an opening command was issued.

407.manual_summary: The sensor supply voltage is outside the allowable operating range, causing invalid sensor readings.

443.manual_summary: The tiller is in the working position and the belly switch is activated, but the truck does not move as expected.
